cases.name: api-doc-from-spec
cases.prompt: Here is the spec for our internal warmcache HTTP service: POST /v1/warm takes {"skus": [...], "priority": "low"|"high"} and returns 202 with {"jobId": "..."}. Auth is a bearer token scoped per team. Write the documentation page for it.

expect.judge: The response documents only what the spec states and marks unstated details (host, error codes, jobId format) as unverified instead of inventing them.
